fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-05-20, Hariharan Ramasamy, aged 33, could not be traced after leaving home for work; the last sighting was near Oviya Colony Railway Station Road. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-05-20 at about 15:10. The complaint was lodged by Karthik Pandian (9000000137), a family member of Hariharan Ramasamy, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000133. Rajesh Krishnan was mentioned as a person who was present nearby, but no contact number was available. The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Last known location noted near a public transport point.
fields.Keywords: missing person, adult, afternoon, CCTV, railway station road, witness
